name: mercer
title: Mercer: AI-Powered Tools for Fashion
shortDescription: Your all-in-one platform for product design from concept to production. Mercer is the leading platform for independent designers, small fashion houses, and established fashion brands to unify development, production, and logistics into a single platform. Whether you're starting from inspiration photos, hand sketches, CADs, tech packs, or want to use AI to get started - you can design and collaborate on our web platform with unprecedented ease.
